scenario_policy.base: Describe the observed reaction and evidence.
scenario_policy.bull: Only if measured crypto strength and supporting flow agree.
scenario_policy.bear: Only if measured crypto weakness and supporting flow agree.
scenario_policy.invalidated: Do not publish a directional setup when evidence conflicts or is stale.

safe_asset_policy: No universal safest-asset claim; compare resilience, volatility and liquidity when data exists.
trade_policy: This engine does not create entry, TP or SL. Downstream verified signal gates remain authoritative.
